base_member_text: Per-interval resets of Num_Zero_Up/HavgSum/HrmsSum are commented out (L253-255), so WaveHeightAve/WaveHeightRMS (L250-251) are cumulative over the whole run since STEADY_TIME, not per averaging window.
audit_member_text: Num_Zero_Up, HavgSum, and HrmsSum reset statements are commented out at lines 253-255, while other interval accumulators are reset at lines 225-242. Consequently the wave-height statistics published at lines 250-251 are cumulative across preview intervals rather than scoped to T_INTV_mean; the intended scope is unresolved.

base_member_text: Cross-line: T_sum is decremented by T_INTV_mean (L224) instead of reset to ZERO while all sums are zeroed (L225-242); the residual T_sum carries into the next interval so subsequent means (sums/T_sum, L147-180) are normalized by a slightly larger denominator; the in-code comment L224 questions this.
audit_member_text: Cross-line averaging-window mismatch: T_sum retains a DT overshoot by subtracting only T_INTV_mean at line 224, but all associated sums are reset to ZERO at lines 225-242. Unless every threshold hit is exact, the next denominator includes residual time for which no numerator contribution remains (lines 144-145,224-242).

base_member_text: Cross-line: in the finalize branch the means Umean/ETAmean etc. are computed (L152-154) only when T_sum crosses T_INTV_mean; UUsum increments (L160-162, L274-276) use U_davg_mean/ETAmean from the previous interval, which is intentional per comments L218-220 but means the first interval uses uninitialized/zero means.
Gravity is hardcoded as 9.80 in radiation-stress and pressure-gradient terms (L187, L191, L193, L195) instead of the GRAV parameter used elsewhere in the code base.

MIXING_STUFF header says it computes Smagorinsky-mixing-related means (L47, L57) but comment L58-59 (ykchoi) notes Umean/Vmean may not be used by other routines; actual consumers are outside this file.

Variables T_sum, T_INTV_mean, ETA2sum, U_davg, P_center, BreakSourceX/Y, ZERO, Emax/Emin, Num_Zero_Up, HavgSum/HrmsSum etc. all come from USE GLOBAL (L109); their declarations/initial values are external to this file.

audit_member_text: UUsum/UVsum/VVsum use U_davg_mean and V_davg_mean at lines 161-163 and 274-276 before the new completed-window means are assigned at lines 170-171; the ELSE path never updates those means. Thus fluctuations are referenced to a previously stored mean (and possibly uninitialized state for the first window), not the current running-window mean (lines 157-176,270-276).

The radiation-stress and depth-integrated-flux stencils iterate I=Ibeg..Iend and J=Jbeg..Jend at lines 184-185 while accessing I-1/I+1 and J-1/J+1 through lines 186-212. This is in bounds only if the GLOBAL ranges exclude physical array edges or provide ghost cells; neither invariant is established in this file.
